commit_scope: Immutable payload commit. The following metadata-only commit adds this manifest; obtain its final tip SHA with git rev-parse HEAD or the delivery message.
self_hash_policy: This manifest does not hash itself. Every other project file at the final branch tip is listed in included_files; Git identifies the manifest-bearing commit.

excluded_reason: No huge raw trajectories/fields or verbose per-step logs; no caches, environments, temporary frames, copyrighted papers or unrelated experiments. Exact per-file reasons are attached to excluded entries.
exclusion_count_semantics: Inventory paths, not unique physical bytes; local copies and server mirrors can overlap. Historical manifests describe the original full dataset, not this curated branch.
file_sizes: Each included_files entry contains size_bytes; excluded entries contain size.
sha256: Each included_files entry contains a fresh SHA-256. Excluded entries identify computed, sealed-manifest, or unavailable digests; local-only hashes are not asserted as verified remote hashes.
reference_physics: Individual-bubble aggregation remains upstream reference physics and is not replaced by an assumed ellipsoid.
